sourceAdaptation.stockWindowsPalOperations: Runtime/PalRedhawk.h, Runtime/PalRedhawkFunctions.h, Runtime/windows/PalRedhawkCommon.cpp, and Runtime/windows/PalRedhawkMinWin.cpp expose or forward VM, context, thread, event/wait, module, loader, thunk, timing, and termination operations beyond the contract
sourceAdaptation.gcBoundary: gc/windows/gcenv.windows.cpp is a full Windows OS adapter, not a five-operation VM shim; it includes synchronization/event, affinity/NUMA, process-memory, write-watch, timing, and Windows privilege APIs
sourceAdaptation.packageBoundary: Microsoft.NETCore.Native.targets selects Microsoft.NETCore.Native.Windows.targets for _targetOS=win; that target adds Windows SDK libraries, WindowsAPIs.txt, UCRT defaults, and the Windows bootstrapper/runtime asset family
sourceAdaptation.coreLibBoundary: System.Private.CoreLib contains Windows-specific time, entropy, loader, COM, environment, process, and interop surfaces; reachability must be reduced by a target-specific build rather than broad managed edits
sourceAdaptation.estimatedMinimumPatch: No runtime source was modified. A first bounded-looking implementation would touch at least 11 runtime/GC/build files plus targeted CoreLib build items and is estimated at 1500-3000 changed lines before compile-driven iteration; this is a broad source fork, not a Phase 19 PAL forwarding layer.
